import json, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/tmp/fz')
from rp2 import Sim
import copy
MAXSTATES=int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv)>1 else 150
P,R,D=1,2,1
inp=[[[1],[2]]]
sn,window=2,2
acts=["send","delup","deluack","deldown","deldack","drop","retry"]
def clone(s):
    s2=Sim(P,R,D,inp,sn,window)
    s2.buf=list(s.buf); s2.sent=list(s.sent); s2.acked=list(s.acked); s2.upnext=list(s.upnext); s2.floor=s.floor
    s2.received=[[ [x for x in v] for v in row] for row in s.received]
    s2.pend={i:list(v) for i,v in s.pend.items()}; s2.created=s.created
    return s2
class Ent: pass
def nsig(s):
    def ent(e):
        if e is None: return None
        return (e.seq, tuple(sorted(e.ranks)), tuple(e.sum))
    return (tuple(s.sent), tuple(s.acked), tuple(s.upnext), s.floor,
            tuple(tuple(tuple(v) for v in row) for row in s.received),
            tuple(ent(e) for e in s.buf), frozenset((i,p[0],p[1],p[2]) for i,p in s.pend.items()))
def event_kind_name(s, ev, created_ids):
    k=ev[0]
    if k=="send": return "send"
    if k=="retry": return "retry"
    if k=="drop": return "drop"
    # deliver: use the kind of the delivered packet
    pk=s.pend.get(ev[1])
    if pk is None: return "noop"
    return "del"+pk[0]
def preimage(clone0):
    pass
# explore
start=Sim(P,R,D,inp,sn,window)
seen={nsig(start):0}
states=[None]
bfs=[(0,start)]
edges=[]
pending_actions=0
order=list(bfs)
from collections import deque
qq=deque([(0,start)])
MAXE=600
while qq and len(states)<MAXSTATES:
    sid, s = qq.popleft()
    cands=[]
    for i in sorted(s.pend.keys()): cands.append(["deliver",i])
    for i in sorted(s.pend.keys()): cands.append(["drop",i])
    for r in range(P):
        for q in range(R): cands.append(["send",r,q])
    for r in range(P): cands.append(["retry",r])
    for ev in cands:
        s2=clone(s)
        before=s2.created
        try:
            s2.tick(ev)
        except RuntimeError:
            continue
        nid=seen.get(nsig(s2))
        if nid is None and len(states)<MAXSTATES:
            nid=len(states); seen[nsig(s2)]=nid; states.append(s2)
            qq.append((nid,s2))
        if nid is not None:
            name=event_kind_name(s,ev,None)
            # duplicate triples not allowed -> dedupe later
            edges.append([sid,name,nid])
states2=[s if False else None for s in states]
# build states with delivered/slots snapshots
statelist=[]
for i,s in enumerate(states):
    if i==0:
        s=start
    if s is None:
        continue
    exp=[[sum(inp[r][q][j] for r in range(P)) for j in range(D)] for q in range(R)]
    dl=[]
    for r in range(P):
        dl.append([[x for x in v] for v in s.received[r]])
    done=all(len(s.received[r])==R for r in range(P))
    sl=[]
    for e in s.buf:
        if e is not None:
            sl.append({"seq":e.seq,"ranks":sorted(e.ranks),"sum":list(e.sum)})
    statelist.append({"delivered":dl,"slots":sl})
# dedupe edges preserving order
seen_e=set(); ded=[]
for e in edges:
    k=(e[0],e[1],e[2])
    if k in seen_e: continue
    seen_e.add(k); ded.append(k)
out={"op":"audit","inputs":inp,"start":0,"edges":[list(x) for x in ded],"states":statelist,
     "fairness":[{"action":"delup","mode":"weak"},{"action":"deldown","mode":"strong"},{"action":"send","mode":"weak"},{"action":"deluack","mode":"strong"},{"action":"retry","mode":"strong"}]}
sys.stdout.write(json.dumps(out)+"\n")
sys.stderr.write("states=%d edges=%d done_states=%d\n"%(len(statelist),len(ded),sum(1 for x in statelist if all(len(x["delivered"][rr])==R for rr in range(P)))))
EOF
